scope: Fixed-benchmark tuning inside the frozen 14-case registry only

v1_aggressive_sharp.description: Sharper local refinement with denser active alpha grids.

v2_sharp_11pt.description: More aggressive grid refinement, intended as a higher-variance pilot.

v3_apce_calibrated.description: A slightly softer APCE branch to preserve calibration while keeping PCE sharp.

v4_state_power2.description: Keep cognitive evidence updates unchanged, but sharpen state-output branch weights with power=2.

v5_state_power4_blend.description: Sharper state-output weights with confidence-gated MAP blending; alpha estimator remains unchanged.

v6_state_map_dominant.description: High-confidence cases use near-MAP state output while retaining evidence-weighted cognitive tracking.

v7_narrow_grid_map.description: Narrower 5-point local alpha grids plus moderate MAP-blended state output.

v8_narrow_grid_map_dominant.description: Aggressive narrow-grid + MAP-dominant state output for the highest-confidence path.

v9_branch_collapse_hybrid.description: Narrow local grid plus confidence-gated branch collapse toward the dominant alpha path.

v10_case_targeted_hybrid.description: Case-family targeted strengthening: aggressive collapse on the cases that currently lose most to Aug-EnKF/BMA, milder settings elsewhere.

v11_continuous_map_point_estimate.description: Use the continuous MAP branch mean as the point estimator while keeping the v8-like probability update.

v12_iterative_analysis_map_point_estimat.description: Continuous MAP point estimate plus two-pass post-observation analysis refinement.

v13_targeted_hard_cases_only.description: Keep v7-like mild settings on stable cases, but apply strong MAP/collapse/iterative refinement only to the hard cases that still lose to Aug-EnKF/BMA.

v14_global_analysis_half.description: Blend branch-local DEnKF with weighted global cross-alpha DEnKF at strength 0.5.

v15_global_analysis_full.description: Replace branch-local DEnKF with weighted global cross-alpha DEnKF for PCE/APCE state analysis.

v16_global_analysis_v8.description: Combine the best v8 narrow-grid/MAP-weight profile with full weighted global cross-alpha DEnKF.

v17_global_analysis_dense_grid.description: Dense 11-point local grid with full weighted global cross-alpha DEnKF and weighted state output.

v18_hard_case_moderate_global.description: Keep weighted global analysis on all cases, but increase local resolution and mild collapse only on hard cases.

v19_confidence_gated_global_v16.description: Use the v16 weighted-mean/global-analysis profile, but gate global analysis by evidence confidence so weak cases fall back to local DEnKF.

v20_member_alpha_jitter_012.description: Use the v16 weighted-mean/global-analysis profile and add a mild member-wise alpha spread inside each branch.

v21_member_alpha_jitter_020.description: Same as v20 but with a slightly stronger member-wise alpha spread to test whether broader intra-branch exploration helps state metrics.

v22_soft_hard_cases_moderate_global.description: Keep the v16 core on easy cases, but soften the output layer and use a milder global analysis on the hard cases that still lag Aug-EnKF.

v23_best_of_pilots_mixed.description: Combine the best-performing per-case settings seen in the current 1-seed pilots, while keeping the frozen benchmark fixed.

v24_joint_alpha_analysis_v16.description: Keep the v16 core settings, add mild member-wise alpha spread, and let each branch perform a joint state-plus-alpha DEnKF update after the usual state analysis.

v25_joint_alpha_analysis_full_v16.description: Same as v24, but use a full-strength joint state-plus-alpha DEnKF update inside each branch.

v26_quadratic_map_hard_cases.description: Keep the v25 full-strength joint state-plus-alpha update, but use quadratic MAP output estimation and denser local regridding on the hard cases.

v27_case_routed_best_evidence.description: Case-routed fixed-benchmark profile assembled from the best 1-seed evidence: v19 for chemical, v17 for gordon_schaefer/pendulum/rl_circuit, v26 for duffing, v23 for fhn/logistic/pk_infusion/sir/sis/van_der_pol, and stable weighted settings elsewhere.

v28_duffing_global_alpha_025.description: v27 plus mild global weighted state-alpha DEnKF only on duffing to try to cross the BMA nRMSE margin.

v29_v27_with_exact_v26_duffing.description: v27, but duffing uses the full v26 joint-alpha method-level settings plus the v26 quadratic hard-case override.

v30_v29_duffing_global_alpha_025.description: v29 plus mild global weighted state-alpha DEnKF on duffing to target the BMA nRMSE margin.

v31_duffing_global_alpha_050.description: v29 with duffing-only global weighted state-alpha DEnKF strength 0.50.

v31_duffing_global_alpha_075.description: v29 with duffing-only global weighted state-alpha DEnKF strength 0.75.

v31_duffing_global_alpha_100.description: v29 with duffing-only global weighted state-alpha DEnKF strength 1.00.

v32_duffing_global_alpha_050_sharp.description: v29 with duffing-only global alpha strength 0.50 plus sharper APCE/PCE state output.

v32_duffing_global_alpha_075_sharp.description: v29 with duffing-only global alpha strength 0.75 plus sharper APCE/PCE state output.
